scope: First-image runtime uses a separate bootstrap journal, continuous health, staged-default selection, authorized watchdog completion and a separate normal-boot health window. Initial staging/activation and production baseline provisioning remain unimplemented.

pi5_validation.artifact_build_state: Built from the source working tree subsequently committed as implementation_commit; this is a test executable, not a clean Yocto runtime image.
pi5_validation.scope: Temporary ordinary-user journal/boot-file fixtures, pure loaded-boot evidence checks, synthetic health/coordinator and fake watchdog, plus actual small ext4 artifact inspection. No fixed-path root adapter, live selector or actual watchdog access.

covered_cases: Trial health must persist before selector promotion and watchdog completion; the normal boot requires a different health proof and boot ID.
Service restart does not extend the boot-relative deadline; partial continuity is discarded and failed attempts cannot automatically retry.
Journal publication faults poison the handle and reopening trusts only a complete published checksummed record. Missing, corrupt, conflicting, linked, changed or pending-only state fails closed.
Selector failures preserve a complete old or new file, retain other assets and recheck authority after preparation. Changed assets and expired authorization prevent selection.
Loaded image, kernel, profile, board/medium, layout, selected root, firmware flag and trial token must match the recorded plan.
Bootstrap watchdog completion requires durable promoted health and uses the existing exact driver, timeout, early-evidence and idempotent completion checks.
Mount-source validation rejects wrong subtree roots, mount paths, devices, filesystems and duplicate IDs using synthetic mountinfo.
The real small ext4 fixture requires a supported runtime marker during packaging and root-install image checks; schema 1/2 and incomplete replacement inventories are rejected.
limits: No production tool creates the initial boot-trial record or stages/activates the first trial yet. Runtime open never initializes a missing attempt.
No clean Yocto runtime image or schema-3 kits have been built. Existing c14c53f/schema-2 kits do not contain this implementation and must not be relabeled.
No installed Pi root, boot file, service, persistent data store, radio configuration, watchdog or reboot was changed. Only temporary files were used on Pi 5; Pi 4 was not exercised in this step.
The full fixed-path privileged bootstrap adapter and systemd writable-subtree namespace have not been exercised on a prepared device. The new bind-source test uses synthetic mountinfo.
Fault injection and ext4 file tests do not qualify physical FAT power-loss behavior, real watchdog handoff, kernel failure or reboot recovery.

Root connection details, supervised preservation/access checks, live root installation, staging, trial activation, canonical migration, explicit production baseline and both-board physical qualification remain outstanding.
End-to-end feed, service, scheduling, radio/maintenance and UI integration are still required before automatic update rollout.
